{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.58

|gr1= GUI Control - ListBox

|descr= Sets tooltip for item with given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given data.

|s1= [[lbSetTooltip]] [idc, index, tooltip]

|p1= idc: [[Number]]

|p2= index: [[Number]]

|p3= tooltip: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= control [[lbSetTooltip]] [index, tooltip]

|p21= control: [[Control]]

|p22= index: [[Number]]

|p23= tooltip: [[String]]

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>lbSetTooltip [101, 1, "tooltip"];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_control lbSetTooltip [0, "another tooltip"];</sqf>

|seealso= [[lbTooltip]] [[lnbSetTooltip]] [[lbAdd]] [[lbClear]] [[lbColor]] [[lbCurSel]] [[lbData]] [[lbDelete]] [[lbIsSelected]] [[lbPicture]] [[lbSelection]] [[lbSetColor]] [[lbSetCurSel]] [[lbSetData]] [[lbSetPicture]] [[lbSetSelected]] [[lbSetValue]] [[lbSize]] [[lbSort]] [[lbSortByValue]] [[lbText]] [[lbValue]]
}}

|text= if you want to put linebreaks into a tooltip, use this method:
